description: Verify that DUT does NOT reassemble when the offset=0 fragment is missing — fragments at offset=1 and offset=2 leave a hole at octets 0..7 (the IP/ICMP header lives there) so reassembly must abort (RFC 791 §3.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Without fragment 0, DUT has no IP header to construct an answer against and no ICMP header to identify the message. Reassembly must wait, then time out — never delivering a half-baked datagram upstream.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: fragment at offset=1 (MF=1)
2. Tester → DUT: fragment at offset=2 (MF=0)
   ⇒ Holes at octets 0..7 (where the IP+ICMP headers would live) remain unfilled.

3. Observation (extended, > reassembly timeout):
   • DUT → Tester: nothing

[Pass condition]
DUT does not emit any Echo Reply.

[Fail condition]
Fail_dut_replied — DUT replied despite missing fragment 0. Reassembly accepted incomplete data.

verdicts.Pass: DUT silently abandoned the incomplete reassembly — normal
verdicts.Fail_dut_replied: DUT replied despite missing fragment 0 — incomplete reassembly accepted
